text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold positions at gains, but a realized profit alone is not a reason to sell; I should compare each holding’s future risk and return with alternatives.","Buying Stock A and Stock E after earlier trades did not give me an edge: prices move randomly, so I should not treat past moves or my trading history as a forecast.","My account grew overall despite several down months and periods without trades; I should stay patient, keep decisions aligned with portfolio risk and diversification, and avoid trading just to relieve regret or lock in a gain."]}
